findings.text: UiSystemTestRunner does not implement the approved mandatory SLICE-002 partitions it claims to cover. The registered first-window test exercises only a small subset of TS-TEST-002/003/011, the cleanup test replaces View:Clear with one immediate Error for each lifecycle, and the transition test covers only one pooled Open timeout. Concrete mandatory partitions absent from the runner include reentrant same-window Add/parameterless Close NoOp behavior (TS-TEST-003), recursive/yielding child cleanup with sibling/resource continuation and explicit clean/dirty/failed use-token behavior (TS-TEST-007), and Busy/absolute-deadline/stale-continuation/destroy-timeout/never-ending-lease cases (TS-TEST-009). The timeout fixture also forces Delay to task.defer while the hook uses task.wait, so it does not deterministically model the injected absolute clock/deadline contract. This leaves the slice's mandatory coverage identities unproven even though the two targeted runtime remediations are present.
